title: Leo's New Year: refresh. refresh.
caption: 2016 Leo counted down alone, refreshing a chat that never answered, then toasted its own reflection. 2026 Leo was so deep in a story on a rooftop it looked up at 12:03. Best midnight ever missed. Who makes you lose track of time?
